themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Covers AI agents that autonomously perform research tasks, analyze data, and generate insights, often acting as independent researchers or assistants.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Focuses on AI tools that assist developers and researchers in writing, debugging, and optimizing code, accelerating software development and research workflows.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Encompasses a broad category of AI-powered platforms and applications designed to facilitate and enhance various aspects of research processes.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Examines how AI is reshaping jobs, skills, and the overall labor market, including discussions on job displacement, creation, and augmentation.

themes.name: AI sentiment feedback
themes.description: Deals with AI's role in analyzing and understanding user sentiment, reviews, and feedback to gauge product perception and customer satisfaction.

themes.name: AI testing automation
themes.description: Covers AI applications in automating testing processes for software, products, and research outputs, aiming for efficiency and accuracy.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Investigates the development, capabilities, and impact of AI chatbots, including their use in research, customer interaction, and personal assistance.

themes.name: AI research platform
themes.description: Highlights AI-driven platforms specifically built to support and streamline research activities, offering integrated tools for data analysis and insight generation.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Explores the application of AI in enhancing the design process and informing research methodologies, from ideation to testing.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Focuses on AI's ability to condense large volumes of text, research papers, or conversations into concise summaries for quicker understanding.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
